_comment: Every fact about the business lives in this one file. Change it here and it
changes everywhere on the site — page copy, the footer, the phone links, and
the structured data Google reads.
The contact details below were taken from the business's public listings
(Yelp, Yahoo Local, Angi, Experience.com, hub.biz) in August 2026. Check them
against what your uncle actually says before launch — directories go stale.
Anything still starting with 'TODO:' is unfilled; `npm run build` lists them.
url is the ORIGIN only (no path). basePath is the subfolder the site is
served from. On GitHub Pages under a repo name, basePath is that repo name.
When a real domain is connected: url = https://stylemarbleandtile.com and
basePath = "".
site.title: Style Marble and Tile
site.description: Marble, granite, and quartz countertop fabrication and tile installation in Hampton Bays, NY. Serving the East End of Long Island since the 1980s. Free estimates.

business.name: Style Marble and Tile
business.tagline: A full-service marble, granite, and quartz fabricator on the East End.
business.intro: Style Marble and Tile is a hard-surface fabrication shop and tile showroom in Hampton Bays. We cut and install kitchen countertops, vanity tops, backsplashes, fireplaces, pool coping, and BBQ counters in marble, granite, quartz, limestone, onyx, bluestone, and solid surface — and we carry the tile to go with them.
business._founded_note: Directory listings say the shop started in 1987, but their own copy has said 'in business 30 years' for a while. Confirm the real year and put it here — an accurate 'since XXXX' is a strong trust signal. Left blank so nothing wrong gets published.
business._license_note: Suffolk County Home Improvement License number. Ask for it — displaying it converts skeptical homeowners.

links._google_note: Get these two from the Google Business Profile dashboard once it is claimed. googleReview is the short 'ask for reviews' link Google generates for you.

forms._comment: Free options: Formspree (formspree.io), Web3Forms, or Basin. Create a form, paste its POST URL here. Until then the form falls back to opening the visitor's email client addressed to the business.

Substrate prep, crack isolation, and heated floors

Table tops, bar tops, and cut-to-size slab

services.name: Outdoor Kitchens & Pool Coping
services.summary: BBQ counters, pool coping, and patio stone built for East End winters.
services.description: Freeze-thaw out here is hard on outdoor stone. We spec and set material that handles it — BBQ and outdoor kitchen counters, pool coping and waterline tile, and bluestone patios and walkways.

differentiators.title: We fabricate it ourselves
differentiators.body: Templating, fabrication, and installation are all in house. Nothing gets lost in a handoff between a fabricator and an installer who have never met, and if something needs adjusting on install day, the people who cut it are standing there.

differentiators.title: A showroom you can walk into
differentiators.body: Stone is hard to choose from a photograph. Come to the shop on Montauk Highway, put your hands on the material, and get a straight answer on how marble, quartzite, and quartz actually differ once they are in a kitchen you cook in.

differentiators.title: The hand work still gets done by hand
differentiators.body: Most of a countertop is machine work, and that is fine — machines are accurate. But the delicate custom trim pieces get cut by hand, because that is the only way they come out right.

faq.a: We are based in Hampton Bays and work across the South Fork and North Fork — Southampton, Westhampton, Quogue, Bridgehampton, Sag Harbor, East Hampton, Montauk, Riverhead, and the surrounding hamlets. If your town is not on that list, call and ask.

faq.q: Do you sell tile, or only install it?
faq.a: Both. We run a showroom at 150 E Montauk Hwy with tile and slab on display, so you can buy material from us, have us install it, or do both.

faq.q: Can you fabricate a slab I bought somewhere else?
faq.a: Yes. We will fabricate and install a slab you have already bought, and we can also walk the slab yards with you and help you pick one.

faq.q: What is the difference between marble, quartzite, and quartz?
faq.a: Marble is natural stone that etches with acid and patinas over time — beautiful, but it asks something of you. Quartzite is natural and much harder, so it resists etching and scratching. Quartz is engineered and non-porous, which makes it the lowest-maintenance of the three. Come in and we will walk you through the tradeoffs for how you actually use your kitchen.

faq.q: How long does a countertop job take?
faq.a: Typically about one to two weeks from template to install, depending on material availability. You get the schedule in writing with the estimate.
Yes. Send the job details through the contact page or call the shop at (631) 728-0049 and we will set up a time to look at it.

_comment: IMPORTANT: only put REAL reviews here, copied verbatim, with the reviewer's
real name. Do not write testimonials. Fake reviews are illegal under the
FTC's rule on consumer reviews (16 CFR Part 465) and Google delists
businesses for them.
There are real 5-star reviews on Yelp and Angi — copy them across as:
{ "author": "First L.", "rating": 5, "date": "2026-05-02", "text": "...", "source": "Yelp" }
Drop photos into src/assets/img/gallery/ and list them here.
The Facebook page already has project photos — pulling the best dozen across
is the single highest-value thing you can add to this site.
Write a real 'alt' for each: it is what a screen reader announces and what
Google Images indexes.
